notes.title: Maid Cafe Release
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce the official release date for upcoming adult game Maid Cafe... You can look forward to playing the game in full on the 25th August 2023. 

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33021098/3fe6184f9887899da32c04fb0feb4f501d8f5dc5.png[/img]

Make sure you wishlist the game now to be notified on release, so that you can enjoy the biggest game we have published. Maid Games have done an amazing job with the development of this game.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33021098/28b5f5aa9e28f131d54905c498d548df9af977b9.png[/img]

It features almost half a million words of dialogue and scripting, over 35 characters to meet and have sexy fun with, plus over 1000 adult illustrations to unlock and enjoy, plus the chance to explore the town, buy items from shops, visit local destinations, go on dates, practice your desserts, learn new recipes and compete in a bake off competition!

Wishlist it now and don't miss out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/423640/Maid_Cafe/

Deluxe Bundles and Discounts available on release, the game also comes with trading cards and Achievements to unlock.

notes.title: Patch v1.16
notes.notes:
Version 1.16 is now live on Steam, which includes a variety of bug fixes:

 - Corrected some backgrounds that were showing incorrectly
 - Replaced several backgrounds with newer versions that suited the scenes more.
 - Updated the Gallery to remove old illustrations from when the game was to be censored.
 - Updated the harem ending to include an additional illustration image.
 - Fixed a bug where Senpai's name appeared when it shouldn't have done.
 - Fixed two images with errors when Mira and Senpai are on the Ferris wheel.
 - Fixed all reported bugs within the game.
 - Fixed a whole host of grammar/typo's within the game.
 - Removed some text that made no sense in the story [i](remnants from older versions of the script)[/i]
 - Adjusted some lines of text to make more sense based on the current events.
 - Corrected several font issues where it was trying to show unknown characters.

notes.title: Release Date Confirmed
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that Roomie Romance has completed its review with Steam and will be released completely uncensored on September 13th 2019

https://store.steampowered.com/app/467720/Roomie_Romance/

This is a Yuri/Lesbian romance story between two people with multiple routes, plenty of fun shinangans and multiple endings including some crazy events and some fun harem style endings to enjoy as well.

We will also be releasing a series of bonus stories that will be released in stages after the the game is officially released via a DLC pack called Extra Stories, that will feature six additional stories that follow the characters after the ending of the standard game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1104860/Roomie_Romance__Extra_Stories/

This DLC will be available to purchase on release with some stories immediately available and the rest released gradually afterwards.
